author: Unity
description:
In this tutorial, we’ll take a closer look at the Unity Studio user interface. Learn how to navigate essential panels like the Hierarchy, Project, Inspector, and Scene View. We’ll also show you how to add 3D models, move around your scene, and adjust object properties.

For assistance or questions, please check out our documentation for helpful articles and guides:
https://on.unity.com/StudioInterface

If you still need help, contact our support team at: 
unitystudio-support@unity3d.com
title: Unity Studio – Exploring the Interface: Basic UI Elements
